name: pdsa-points-web
description: Static frontend for the PDSA points system: member check-in and the officer review queue. No build step, no dependencies, no framework.

scripts.lint:no-em-dash: bash -c 'grep -rn $'\''\xe2\x80\x94'\'' . --exclude-dir=node_modules && { echo "em dash found"; exit 1; } || echo "no em dashes"'
scripts.check: npm run lint:no-em-dash && npm run verify && npm run verify:admin
